name: find_subject_v1
scope: Synthetic public-safe subject relevance regression; no personal facts or answer-generation evaluation.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval ranking decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval ranking decision
Atlas retrieval decisions rank subject identity before generic word overlap.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval delivery decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval delivery decision
Atlas retrieval decisions send short supporting passages first; useful partial evidence is retained.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval synonyms decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval synonyms decision
Atlas retrieval decisions retain semantic paraphrases even when a query word is absent.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval cost decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval cost decision
Atlas retrieval decisions use existing embeddings and a cheap local ranking pass without a new language model per query.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval duplicates decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval duplicates decision
Atlas retrieval decisions collapse repeated excerpts while distinct sources remain independently citable.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval limits decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval limits decision
Atlas retrieval decisions allow more than five genuinely relevant sources when the response budget permits.

sources.title: Atlas retrieval evaluation decision
sources.text:
# Atlas retrieval evaluation decision
Atlas retrieval decisions measure delivered evidence against frozen source labels and check lost relevant evidence.

sources.title: Atlas project overview
sources.text:
# Atlas project overview
Atlas is an evidence library storing source files and notes. Its icon is a blue compass; this overview describes branding.

sources.title: Kestrel animation retrieval decisions
sources.text:
# Kestrel animation retrieval decisions
Kestrel retrieves Blender texture assets from a shared drive. Retrieval decisions select the newest PNG and exclude broken thumbnails. Retrieval ranking uses texture dimensions.

sources.title: General information retrieval glossary
sources.text:
# General information retrieval glossary
Retrieval systems rank search results by similarity. Retrieval decisions include precision, recall, ranking and delivery. This glossary defines general search concepts.

sources.title: Atlas backup restoration checklist
sources.text:
# Atlas backup restoration checklist
Before restoring an Atlas snapshot, pause writers. Resume writes after the checksum audit passes. Rebuild the retrieval index from restored files.

sources.title: Riverside interruption test
sources.text:
# Riverside interruption test
Disconnected Riverside tablets kept unsent changes. Twelve simulated devices completed the reconnect exercise. A field success rate has not been measured.

sources.title: Riverside brand notes
sources.text:
# Riverside brand notes
The Riverside tablet inspection app uses a green river logo. Its brand guide recommends short labels for recovery and synchronization screens.

sources.title: Tablet journal approval record
sources.text:
# Tablet journal approval record
The inspection tablet project is also called Riverside. An administrator must approve the recovery bundle before replacing a device. Pending edits remain locked until the key is recovered.

sources.title: Offline map package handoff
sources.text:
# Offline map package handoff
The download service is internally codenamed Northstar. The package worker retains the previous bundle until the replacement checksum has been verified.

limitations: Manual source and anchor labels exclude topic-only and generic overlap documents.
Partial evidence is relevant without answering every part of a question.
Proper-name-absence cases keep identity in source context while supporting anchors omit the name.
Seven independent relevant sources guard against a universal five-result cap.
Hashing embeddings are an offline lexical check, not a claim about semantic-model quality or population precision.
